title: The Settlers Pray, Fight, and Overthrow Chattarsal

blocks.text: As danger closes in, the Mehraj people go first to Bhai Bhagtu rather than to worldly officials. The answer is stark and devotional: bhagatâ kahi ab ôt nahin aurai, meaning that no refuge remains except ardas and trust in the Guru.

That prayer becomes the ground of collective resistance. New allies join the threatened settlers, the invader's army is met in battle, and the attacking force is broken badly enough that Chattarsal himself is isolated and killed.
This is the true climax of the early Malwa arc. The community does not survive by flight alone, but by turning remembered blessing into armed self-defense under spiritual assurance.
